name: add_subtasks_to_task
description: Append new child subtasks to one existing Sunsama task, identified by its task id. Use this only when the user named a task that already exists and asked to break it into steps or add steps to it. It does not create tasks, does not reorder or rename existing subtasks, and does not apply to any other app's tasks - create the parent task first if it does not exist, and do not infer subtasks the user did not ask for.

taskId.description: The ID of the parent task
